company.name: Tracebit
company.shortDescription: Tracebit provides a cloud threat detection and deception platform that employs decoy systems to attract and capture attackers.
company.description: The answer to Assume Breach. Most breaches aren’t detected for months. Tracebit detects them in seconds. Deploy canaries across your environment that trigger high-fidelity alerts when attackers move laterally, escalate privileges or access credentials.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud threat detection and deception platform that deploys canaries—realistic decoy resources, credentials, identities, and applications—to detect attacker activity with high-confidence alerts.

productsAndServices.description: The enterprise offering of Tracebit’s canary platform, providing broad environment coverage, automated deployments, enterprise integrations, and management capabilities for production security programs.

productsAndServices.description: A free edition that deploys canary credentials for GitHub repositories and other limited environments, alerting users when an attacker accesses a canary.
